findings.evidence: "When `web2md` is missing ... copy the CLI's stderr blocker message into the report and stop." The preceding `command -v web2md` check can fail without producing a CLI stderr message.

findings.evidence: "a directory path means one file per URL" relies on title-based auto-naming, so two pages with the same title can resolve to the same output path and overwrite one another.
findings.fix: For batch directory output, detect or prevent filename collisions before writing each result; choose distinct confirmed paths or ask the user how to resolve a collision, and validate every resulting file.
